result.title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
result.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Foundational architecture paper; companion evaluation paper forthcoming
result.summary: Modern distributed microservice deployments generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, multi-format observability logs across physically and logically partitioned infrastructure. Isolating root causes during cascading failures remains an arduous task for Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), bottlenecked by manual keyword filtering and disjointed temporal correlation across monitoring dashboards. We introduce Semantic Observability, an autonomous multi-agent framework that unifies disparate log streams into a dynamic, queryable Property Graph Database. By modeling physical infrastructure topologies, logical software dependencies, and chronological event sequences as attributed nodes and directed relations, it bridges the semantic gap inherent in flat, unstructured log repositories. Building on this unified substrate, we deploy a stateful multi-agent system orchestrated through Directed Cyclic Graphs (DCGs). The system autonomously navigates the topology, applying causal graph algorithms and temporal back-traversal to isolate the precise blast radius of anomalies. The pruned subgraph is then interpreted by a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning engine to generate contextualized, code-level Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and actionable remediations. This paper establishes the foundational system architecture, formal relational ontology, and multi-agent control loops of Semantic Observability. We show conceptually how the framework eliminates ambient telemetry noise, reduces Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), compresses LLM token consumption, and prevents structural hallucinations. We also specify an open-source validation framework on standard benchmarks (LogHub and Train-Ticket), laying the groundwork for a forthcoming companion paper on exhaustive quantitative evaluation and production benchmarking.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出「Semantic Observability」框架，将多源异构日志统一建模为可查询的属性图，并用有状态多智能体循环（DCG 编排）结合因果图算法与时间回溯裁剪故障子图，再由 LLM 生成根因分析与修复建议；本文只给架构、关系本体与验证框架，量化评测留待后续。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先按因果/拓扑关系裁剪证据子图，再交 LLM 推理」的有状态控制循环，或许可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 STOP 决策的类比线索，但领域距多模态推理较远且尚无量化结果，迁移性需自行判断。
